description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. This AERPAW Autonomous Data Mule release combines USRP link measurements, UAV telemetry, LoRa observations, Keysight RF position estimates and Fortem radar tracking. DataCite describes 11 finalist teams with 33 physical competition flights, development flights in a digital twin, and three additional RF/radar flights. Missions optimise downloads from distributed base stations within 500 seconds. The catalogue entries numbered 28 and 30 point to this same DOI; the RF/radar observations are a subset of this release. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Autonomous wireless-network scheduling and digital-twin calibration. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
